presets.name: AI & Local LLM Inference Turbo
presets.description: Prepares your workstation for local LLM token generation & PyTorch: frees standby RAM, unlocks Ultimate Power, extends GPU TDR timeout, enables HAGS, tunes Ollama Flash Attention, and optimizes WSL2.

presets.name: Maximum Build & Compile Speed
presets.description: Accelerates Visual Studio, .NET, Rust Cargo, and Node builds: configures Defender exclusions, NTFS small-file turbo, pauses Search Indexer, exempts compilers from EcoQoS throttling, and tunes Git.

presets.name: Deep Focus & Developer Ergonomics
presets.description: Sets up a distraction-free daily coding environment: mutes toast notifications, enables Snappy UI, configures Explorer extensions & hidden files, enables Win+V clipboard history, and blocks Start Menu Bing ads.

presets.name: On-The-Go Ultra Battery Endurance
presets.description: Maximizes laptop unplugged runtime: caps DC CPU turbo boost, activates Ultra-Endurance Battery profile, stops OneDrive & P2P update uploads, and audits wake-armed devices.

presets.name: Deep Storage Clean & Privacy Shield
presets.description: Creates a System Restore Point, purges temp/shader/browser/IDE caches, minimizes Windows telemetry, and disables Activity History.

scripts.name: Purge Standby & Working Set RAM
scripts.description: Trims idle working sets across background processes using the Win32 psapi EmptyWorkingSet API and reports reclaimed physical memory.

scripts.name: Developer Snappy UI Visual Effects
scripts.description: Disables slow window minimize/maximize animations, taskbar sliding, and menu fade delays while preserving ClearType font smoothing and crisp icon thumbnails.

scripts.name: NVMe SysMain (Superfetch) Optimizer
scripts.description: Inspects primary storage media type (NVMe/SSD vs HDD) and tunes the SysMain service and Prefetcher parameters to prevent background I/O spikes during heavy builds.

scripts.name: NTFS Small-File & Monorepo I/O Boost
scripts.description: Tunes NTFS behavior (disables 8.3 legacy short names and last-access timestamp writes, increases NTFS paged pool memory) to speed up node_modules and git operations.

scripts.name: Win32PrioritySeparation Foreground Boost
scripts.description: Configures the Windows kernel scheduler quantum (Win32PrioritySeparation = 0x26) for short, variable, high foreground boost so active IDEs and interactive apps never stutter.

scripts.name: NVMe ReTrim & Storage Slab Optimizer
scripts.description: Issues TRIM/ReTrim commands across all fixed SSD and NVMe volumes via Optimize-Volume so the SSD controller can pre-erase stale NAND blocks for peak write speed.

scripts.name: Pause Windows Search Indexer (Build Mode)
scripts.description: Temporarily pauses or resumes the Windows Search Indexer (WSearch) so massive file generation during compilation, git checkout, or npm install doesn't trigger CPU/disk spikes.

scripts.name: MMCSS Low-Latency System Responsiveness
scripts.description: Configures the Multimedia Class Scheduler Service (MMCSS) SystemResponsiveness and disables NetworkThrottlingIndex to prevent multimedia packet throttling.

scripts.name: Startup App & Prelauncher Slimmer
scripts.description: Audits all user and machine Run registry entries plus startup folders, and disables Microsoft Edge background pre-launching and startup boost.

scripts.name: Disable GameDVR Background Frame Capture
scripts.description: Disables Xbox GameDVR background video recording hooks (AppCaptureEnabled / GameDVR_Enabled) to eliminate frame-time spikes in GPU-accelerated apps and games.

scripts.name: Unlock & Activate Ultimate Performance Plan
scripts.description: Unlocks Microsoft's hidden Ultimate Performance power scheme (e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61) via powercfg and activates it to eliminate CPU core parking delays.

scripts.name: Ultra-Endurance On-The-Go Battery Profile
scripts.description: Switches to Power Saver scheme, caps maximum processor state at 70% on battery (DC) power to prevent turbo power drain, and sets aggressive idle timeouts.

scripts.name: CPU Turbo Boost Thermal & Fan Controller
scripts.description: Reveals the hidden Processor Performance Boost Mode setting in Power Options and lets you toggle between Aggressive, Efficient Enabled, or Disabled for silent/cool operation.

scripts.name: Disable PCIe Link State Power Management (ASPM)
scripts.description: Disables PCI Express Active State Power Management (ASPM) on AC power so discrete GPUs and NVMe drives don't experience wake-up latency micro-stutters.

scripts.name: USB Selective Suspend Guard for Dev Hardware
scripts.description: Disables USB Selective Suspend on AC power so hardware debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, ADB phones), audio interfaces, and KVM switches never randomly disconnect.

scripts.name: Toggle Fast Startup & Hibernation Space Saver
scripts.description: Configures Windows Fast Startup (HiberbootEnabled) and hibernation file size (Reduced vs Off) to guarantee clean kernel reloads or reclaim up to 32GB of SSD space.

scripts.name: Battery Wear Level & Cycle Count Inspector
scripts.description: Queries WMI BatteryStaticData / BatteryFullChargedCapacity and generates an XML/HTML battery report to calculate exact battery wear percentage and remaining health.

scripts.name: Exempt Compilers & IDEs from EcoQoS Throttling
scripts.description: Uses powercfg /powerthrottling to exempt developer toolchains (VS Code, Visual Studio, Node, Python, Rust Cargo, .NET) from Windows 11 EcoQoS efficiency-core throttling.

scripts.name: Workstation AC Processor State Tuner
scripts.description: Configures Minimum and Maximum Processor State on AC power (e.g., 10% min for cool idle, 100% max for full boost, or 100%/100% locked for latency benchmarking).

scripts.name: Modern Standby & Phantom Wake Auditor
scripts.description: Inspects last wake sources, active wake timers, power requests keeping the PC awake, and wake-armed hardware devices to stop backpack battery drain.

scripts.name: Extend GPU TDR Timeout for Local LLM / CUDA Kernels
scripts.description: Increases Windows Display Driver Timeout Detection & Recovery (TdrDelay = 60s, TdrDdiDelay = 60s) so heavy PyTorch, DirectML, or Stable Diffusion kernels don't crash the GPU driver.

scripts.name: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
scripts.description: Enables Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HwSchMode = 2) so the GPU's dedicated scheduling processor manages VRAM queues directly for lower inference latency.

scripts.name: Ollama Local LLM Flash-Attention & KV-Cache Tuner
scripts.description: Configures Ollama environment variables (OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1, OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=15m) to cut context VRAM usage by nearly 50%.

scripts.name: VRAM Pre-Flight Cleaner for AI Inference
scripts.description: Queries GPU VRAM utilization and identifies non-essential desktop apps consuming dedicated video memory (overlays, game launchers, background webviews) so large models fit in VRAM.

scripts.name: WSL2 .wslconfig AI & CUDA Memory Optimizer
scripts.description: Generates an optimized ~/.wslconfig with gradual autoMemoryReclaim, sparseVhd, mirrored networking, and dynamic RAM sizing (75% of host RAM) for PyTorch/vLLM inside WSL2.

scripts.name: AI Model Weights Cache Auditor (HF, Ollama, Torch)
scripts.description: Scans HuggingFace Hub (~/.cache/huggingface), Ollama (~/.ollama/models), LM Studio, and PyTorch Hub caches to report disk usage by model and clean orphaned .lock/incomplete files.

scripts.name: NVIDIA GPU Compute Power & Clock Tuner
scripts.description: Queries nvidia-smi for GPU power limits, thermal throttling reasons, P-State, and memory clocks, and applies optimal compute power limits for sustained token generation.

scripts.name: Windows Copilot & Recall Resource Controller
scripts.description: Toggles Windows built-in Copilot sidebar and Recall snapshot analysis policies so you can dedicate 100% of NPU/GPU/RAM resources to your own local AI models or re-enable Windows AI.

scripts.name: Python AI Toolchain, CUDA & ONNX Doctor
scripts.description: Diagnoses Python installations, uv/conda/pip environments, CUDA_PATH SDK versions, nvcc compiler availability, and checks if PyTorch/ONNX Runtime can see GPU hardware.

scripts.name: NPU, GPU & DirectML Accelerator Inventory
scripts.description: Enumerates all Display Adapters and Neural Processing Units (ComputeAccelerator PnP class) to verify NPU/GPU driver versions, PCIe vendor IDs, and DirectML readiness.

scripts.name: Defender Real-Time Build & Compiler Exclusions
scripts.description: Adds Microsoft Defender Antivirus process and folder exclusions for compilers (dotnet, node, cargo, rustc, msbuild, git) and source workspaces to cut build times by up to 60%.

scripts.name: Enable Developer Mode, Sudo & Win32 Long Paths
scripts.description: Enables Windows Developer Mode (unprivileged symlinks & app sideloading) and removes the legacy 260-character MAX_PATH limit (LongPathsEnabled = 1) for deep npm/Rust trees.

scripts.name: Zombie Localhost Dev Port Reaper
scripts.description: Scans common development ports (3000, 3001, 4200, 5000, 5173, 8000, 8080, 8888) for orphaned Node, Python, .NET, or Java processes holding EADDRINUSE locks and terminates them.

scripts.name: Stale node_modules & Build Artifact Pruner
scripts.description: Scans developer directories for stale node_modules, .next, dist, and Rust target folders untouched for >30 days and calculates reclaimable gigabytes.

scripts.name: Unified Package Manager Cache Purge (npm/pip/NuGet)
scripts.description: Audits and purges local download caches for npm, pnpm, Yarn, pip, uv, and .NET NuGet http-cache/temp folders to reclaim gigabytes of SSD space.

scripts.name: Git Monorepo & Filesystem Cache Turbo Config
scripts.description: Applies high-performance global Git settings for Windows (core.fscache=true, core.preloadindex=true, feature.manyFiles=true, fetch.parallel=0) for instant git status.

scripts.name: WSL2 & Docker Virtual Disk (ext4.vhdx) Compactor
scripts.description: Locates bloated WSL2 and Docker Desktop ext4.vhdx virtual disk files and shrinks/compacts unused blocks back to the Windows host filesystem.

scripts.name: VS Code / Cursor Cached VSIX & Crashpad Cleaner
scripts.description: Cleans gigabytes of stale CachedExtensionVSIXs, GPUCache, logs, and Crashpad dumps across VS Code, VS Code Insiders, and Cursor without touching settings or extensions.

scripts.name: System & User PATH Deduplicator & Dead-Entry Cleaner
scripts.description: Audits User and Machine PATH variables, detects duplicate entries and non-existent directories that slow down shell command lookup, backs up PATH, and deduplicates.

scripts.name: Dev Drive (ReFS) & Filesystem Filter Driver Auditor
scripts.description: Inspects active filesystem minifilter drivers (fltmc) and checks whether existing volumes use ReFS Dev Drive with asynchronous Defender performance mode.

scripts.name: Docker Engine & BuildKit Cache Deep Prune
scripts.description: Checks Docker daemon status, reports disk usage across images, containers, local volumes, and BuildKit cache, and prunes dangling layers.

scripts.name: WSL2 Distro Inspector & LxssManager Cold Restart
scripts.description: Lists all installed WSL distributions and their states/versions, cleanly shuts down hung WSL2 utility VMs, and restarts the WSL service.

scripts.name: Repair WSL2 / Hyper-V Host Network Service (HNS)
scripts.description: Diagnoses virtual switches and restarts the Host Network Service (hns) and WinNAT when WSL2 or Docker containers lose outbound internet or DNS connectivity.

scripts.name: Generate Isolated Windows Sandbox (.wsb) Profile
scripts.description: Generates a ready-to-launch Windows Sandbox (.wsb) configuration with vGPU acceleration enabled, 8GB RAM allocation, and a read-only shared folder for testing untrusted binaries.

scripts.name: Kubernetes ~/.kube/config Context & Cluster Auditor
scripts.description: Inspects ~/.kube/config permissions, lists configured Kubernetes clusters and contexts, and backs up bloated kubeconfig files.

scripts.name: OpenSSH Agent Auto-Start & Key Permission Hardener
scripts.description: Configures the native Windows OpenSSH Authentication Agent (ssh-agent) service to Automatic startup, starts it, and audits ~/.ssh private key ACL permissions.

scripts.name: Hosts File Local Dev Domain & Docker Entry Auditor
scripts.description: Parses C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts to inspect custom local development domains, Kubernetes/Docker Desktop host mappings, and duplicate overrides.

scripts.name: Cloud CLI Log & Token Cache Cleaner (AWS/Azure/GCP)
scripts.description: Audits ~/.aws, ~/.azure, and %APPDATA%\gcloud for oversized CLI telemetry logs and stale credential caches, cleaning log bloat without removing active profiles.

scripts.name: Hyper-V Hypervisor LaunchType Switcher (Auto vs Off)
scripts.description: Inspects bcdedit hypervisorlaunchtype and lets you switch between 'Auto' (required for WSL2, Docker, Hyper-V) and 'Off' (bare-metal CPU performance & hardware nested counters).

scripts.name: WSL2 / Container to LAN Port Proxy Manager
scripts.description: Displays all active netsh interface portproxy v4tov4 rules and lets you bridge a WSL2 or container port to your Windows LAN IP for mobile/tablet testing.

scripts.name: Flush DNS Resolver Cache & Clear ARP Table
scripts.description: Flushes the Windows DNS Client cache (Clear-DnsClientCache), clears stale Neighbor/ARP cache entries, and verifies active gateway reachability.

scripts.name: Benchmark & Switch to Fastest Public DNS (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8 / 9.9.9.9)
scripts.description: Benchmarks UDP/TCP latency to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google (8.8.8.8), and Quad9 (9.9.9.9) and configures the fastest DNS provider on active network adapters.

scripts.name: TCP Stack, Receive Window Auto-Tuning & RSS Optimizer
scripts.description: Optimizes the Windows TCP/IP stack (Receive Window Auto-Tuning = normal, Receive-Side Scaling = enabled, ECN capability) for maximum fiber/gigabit throughput.

scripts.name: Disable Nagle's Algorithm (TcpAckFrequency & TCPNoDelay)
scripts.description: Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 on active physical network interfaces to eliminate up to 200ms of delayed-ACK packet buffering in SSH terminals and games.

scripts.name: Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Link Quality & Power-Save Optimizer
scripts.description: Inspects Wi-Fi band, channel, RSSI signal quality, RX/TX link rate via netsh wlan, and sets the wireless adapter power saving mode to Maximum Performance on AC power.

scripts.name: Live External TCP Connection & Process Radar
scripts.description: Maps all established outbound TCP connections to their owning process names, PIDs, and remote IP/Port endpoints to spot hidden bandwidth or telemetry consumers.

scripts.name: LAN SMB3 Multichannel & NAS Transfer Optimizer
scripts.description: Audits and enables SMB3 Multichannel and Large MTU support on the Windows SMB client for high-speed multi-gigabit file transfers to local NAS and home servers.

scripts.name: VPN Interface Metric & Orphaned Route Doctor
scripts.description: Inspects active IPv4 default gateways (0.0.0.0/0), VPN TAP/TUN/WireGuard/Tailscale interface metrics, and flushes stuck VPN routes when split tunneling breaks.

scripts.name: Disable Windows Update P2P Upload Bandwidth Drain
scripts.description: Configures Windows Delivery Optimization (DODownloadMode = 0) so your PC doesn't act as a peer-to-peer upload node for other PCs on the internet during work or gaming.

scripts.name: Multi-Target Ping, Jitter & Edge Latency Benchmark
scripts.description: Runs a rapid latency and jitter test against your local gateway, Cloudflare Edge (1.1.1.1), Google DNS (8.8.8.8), and GitHub to isolate Wi-Fi vs ISP lag spikes.

scripts.name: Deep Focus Coding Mode (Mute Toasts & Distractions)
scripts.description: Suppresses Windows Toast popups and notification sounds (NOC_GLOBAL_SETTING_TOASTS_ENABLED = 0) during deep coding or screen recording sessions, with one-click restore.

scripts.name: Instant System & App Dark / Light Mode Switcher
scripts.description: Instantly toggles Windows System UI and App themes between Dark Mode and Daylight High-Contrast Light Mode via registry Personalize keys.

scripts.name: Enable Win+V Multi-Slot Clipboard History & Sanitizer
scripts.description: Enables Windows Win+V Clipboard History (EnableClipboardHistory = 1) for developer productivity and provides a quick sanitizer to clear sensitive tokens from the active clipboard.

scripts.name: File Explorer Developer Ergonomics (Extensions & Hidden Files)
scripts.description: Configures Windows File Explorer for developers: always show file extensions (HideFileExt=0), show hidden dotfiles (Hidden=1), open Explorer to 'This PC' instead of Home, and enable Compact View.

scripts.name: Toggle Windows 11 Full Classic Right-Click Context Menu
scripts.description: Restores the instant, full right-click context menu in Windows 11 (eliminating 'Show more options' extra clicks for 7-Zip, Git Bash, and VS Code) or reverts to modern style.

scripts.name: Restart Windows Audio Stack & Bluetooth Headset Recovery
scripts.description: Cleanly restarts Audiosrv and AudioEndpointBuilder services when USB DACs, Bluetooth headphones, or Teams/Zoom microphone inputs stop responding.

scripts.name: Rescue Off-Screen Stranded Windows to Primary Display
scripts.description: Enumerates top-level application windows after undocking from external monitors and moves any off-screen/negative-coordinate windows back onto the primary display.

scripts.name: Late-Night Coding Display Brightness & Eye-Care Controller
scripts.description: Queries WmiMonitorBrightness / DDC monitor luminance levels and adjusts panel brightness for comfortable late-night coding or bright daytime conditions.

scripts.name: End-of-Day Uncommitted Git Audit & Workspace Wrap-Up
scripts.description: Scans your project folders for Git repositories with uncommitted changes or unpushed commits so you never shut down your PC without pushing your daily work.

scripts.name: WinGet Outdated App Scanner & Silent Upgrader
scripts.description: Queries Windows Package Manager (winget upgrade) to list all installed applications with available updates and optionally performs a silent batch upgrade.

scripts.name: Deep Temp, DirectX & NVIDIA/AMD Shader Cache Purge
scripts.description: Cleans %TEMP%, C:\Windows\Temp, DirectX Shader Cache (D3DSCache), and NVIDIA DXCache/GLCache folders to fix shader stutter and recover gigabytes of SSD space.

scripts.name: WinSxS Component Store & Update Cache Slimmer
scripts.description: Audits C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download and runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup to reclaim gigabytes from superseded Windows updates.

scripts.name: Purge Memory Dumps, Minidumps & WER Crash Queues
scripts.description: Finds and cleans oversized C:\Windows\MEMORY.DMP, %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps, and Windows Error Reporting (WER) ReportQueue/ReportArchive folders.

scripts.name: Empty All Recycle Bins & Inspect VSS Shadow Storage
scripts.description: Empties Recycle Bins across all fixed drives and inspects Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) storage allocation.

scripts.name: Top 25 Largest Files & Forgotten ISO/ZIP Hunter
scripts.description: Scans your Downloads and user profile directories to pinpoint the 25 largest files (.iso, .vhdx, .zip, .safetensors, .gguf, installers) hogging your SSD.

scripts.name: Multi-Browser Media & Code Cache Vacuum (Edge/Chrome/Brave)
scripts.description: Vacuums gigabytes of Chromium Cache_Data, Code Cache, and GPUCache across Edge, Chrome, and Brave while keeping all cookies, logins, bookmarks, and history untouched.

scripts.name: Consumer Appx Bloatware Auditor & Debloater
scripts.description: Identifies and removes pre-installed consumer Appx bloatware (BingNews, BingWeather, SolitaireCollection, MixedReality, GetHelp, People, FeedbackHub) while keeping Store & Xbox intact.

scripts.name: OneDrive Background Sync Controller
scripts.description: Checks if OneDrive.exe is running in the background and lets you cleanly pause/quit OneDrive during heavy builds so it doesn't lock or upload generated project artifacts.

scripts.name: Purge Windows Delivery Optimization Peer Cache
scripts.description: Queries Delivery Optimization cache statistics and invokes Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache to immediately reclaim peer-to-peer update cache space.

scripts.name: AppData Top Space Consumers & Orphaned Folder Auditor
scripts.description: Ranks the top 15 largest top-level directories in %LOCALAPPDATA% and %APPDATA% so you can spot multi-gigabyte leftover folders from uninstalled apps.

scripts.name: Minimize Windows Telemetry & DiagTrack Service
scripts.description: Sets AllowTelemetry to minimum security level, disables Connected User Experiences and Telemetry (DiagTrack) service, and stops background diagnostic uploaders.

scripts.name: Disable Start Menu Bing Web Search & Suggested Ads
scripts.description: Disables Bing web search results in the Windows Start Menu (making local app/file search instant and private) and turns off ContentDeliveryManager lock-screen/Start suggestions.

scripts.name: UAC, SmartScreen & Exploit Guard Posture Auditor
scripts.description: Audits User Account Control (UAC) elevation level, Secure Desktop prompting, SmartScreen status, and Windows Defender Exploit Guard protections.

scripts.name: Windows Firewall Public Profile Inbound Exposure Auditor
scripts.description: Audits Windows Defender Firewall profiles (Domain, Private, Public) and lists any enabled inbound Allow rules exposed on Public Wi-Fi networks.

scripts.name: TPM 2.0, Secure Boot & BitLocker Encryption Inspector
scripts.description: Verifies Secure Boot state (Confirm-SecureBootUEFI), TPM 2.0 readiness, and drive encryption status across all volumes.

scripts.name: USB Mass Storage Write-Protect / Read-Only Shield
scripts.description: Toggles Windows StorageDevicePolicies WriteProtect so external USB thumb drives can be read safely without allowing data exfiltration or malware writes.

scripts.name: Camera & Microphone Hardware Consent Auditor
scripts.description: Inspects HKCU CapabilityAccessManager ConsentStore for webcam and microphone to list every desktop and packaged app that has accessed your camera or mic.

scripts.name: Disable Windows Activity History & Purge Recent Jump Lists
scripts.description: Disables PublishUserActivities and UploadUserActivities policies and optionally clears Recent Files / AutomaticDestinations jump list tracking.

scripts.name: Virtualization-Based Security (VBS / Memory Integrity) Inspector
scripts.description: Queries Win32_DeviceGuard to check Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) and Hypervisor-Enforced Code Integrity (HVCI) status and lets you toggle for max security vs raw compute speed.

scripts.name: Telemetry & Ad-Tracker Hosts Blocklist Manager
scripts.description: Manages a clearly delimited # [WinPulse-Shield] blocklist section in the Windows hosts file to sinkhole common telemetry endpoints to 0.0.0.0, with instant rollback.

scripts.name: Create Instant System Restore Checkpoint
scripts.description: Enables System Restore on C: and creates an immediate timestamped restore point (Checkpoint-Computer) before applying major registry or driver changes.

scripts.name: DISM Image Health & SFC Integrity Verifier
scripts.description: Runs DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /CheckHealth and verifies system component store integrity to detect corrupted Windows system files.

scripts.name: BSOD BugCheck & WHEA Hardware Error Event Analyzer
scripts.description: Queries the Windows System Event Log for recent Kernel-Power (ID 41), BugCheck BSODs (ID 1001), and WHEA hardware PCIe/CPU parity errors over the past 30 days.

scripts.name: NVMe / SSD SMART Health, Temp & Wear Level Monitor
scripts.description: Queries Get-PhysicalDisk and Get-StorageReliabilityCounter to report NVMe/SSD operational health, temperature in Celsius, wear percentage, and read/write error counts.

scripts.name: Physical RAM DIMM Slot, Speed & Dual-Channel Inspector
scripts.description: Inspects Win32_PhysicalMemory to display installed RAM DIMM slots, manufacturer part numbers, configured clock speed (MT/s), and verify XMP/EXPO speed activation.

scripts.name: Force High-Precision NTP Clock Resync (Fix OAuth/JWT Drift)
scripts.description: Starts the Windows Time service (w32time) and forces an immediate NTP clock resynchronization to fix OAuth2, AWS SigV4, Docker, and TLS clock-skew errors after sleep.

scripts.name: Microsoft Store & App Installer Cache Healer
scripts.description: Clears corrupted Microsoft Store local cache folders and verifies Windows Package Manager (AppInstaller) registration.

scripts.name: Flush Stuck Print Spooler & Virtual PDF Queue
scripts.description: Stops the Print Spooler service, purges wedged .SHD and .SPL print jobs in System32\spool\PRINTERS, and restarts the spooler cleanly.

scripts.name: Faulty & Degraded PnP Device Driver Inspector
scripts.description: Scans all Plug-and-Play hardware devices (Win32_PnPEntity) for non-zero ConfigManagerErrorCodes (missing drivers, Code 43 GPU resets, disabled devices).

scripts.name: Export Full Developer & AI Workstation Spec Report (JSON)
scripts.description: Compiles a comprehensive hardware, OS build, CPU, RAM, GPU/VRAM, storage volumes, and developer toolchain report and saves it as a structured JSON snapshot.
